# Ahsan Munir

> Shopify store experience — design and development. Publishes the standard a Shopify store is built and assessed against, so a buyer can evaluate any developer — including this one.

## The standard

Every check below ships with what it catches, how to run it yourself, and what it misses. Published in full at https://growthinn.co/standard/

- **Structure that survives the next change** — Whether the theme can absorb a new section without a developer rewriting a template.
- **A merchant who can edit without calling anyone** — Whether the person who owns the store can change its content without a developer.
- **A performance target that holds as content grows** — Whether the store is fast on the pages that carry real content, measured in numbers rather than impressions.
- **WCAG 2.1 AA, verified — not intended** — Whether accessibility is a measured state or a stated value.
- **Documentation your team can actually use** — Whether the handover is a document or a phone number.
- **Every app's cost, decided deliberately** — Whether anyone costed the apps before installing them.
- **A QA phase with a checklist, not a click-around** — Whether testing is a defined stage or an afternoon.
- **A defined first month after handover** — Whether the riskiest thirty days are scoped or improvised.
- **A store you can change in six months without me** — Whether the exit exists, whether or not you use it.
- **Checkout, end to end** — Whether the checkout completes, not merely renders.
- **The conversion paths, walked** — Whether the paths that carry money were walked or assumed.
- **The browsers your customers actually use** — Whether the tested browsers match the ones in your analytics.
- **Rendering that doesn't make the shopper wait** — Whether Liquid, scripts and third-party code delay the content the shopper actually came for.

## What this site cannot demonstrate

- Checkout, end to end — requires a live Shopify store with real orders.
- The conversion paths, walked — requires a live Shopify store with real orders.
- Rendering that doesn't make the shopper wait — requires a live Shopify store with real orders.

These are published as out of scope for this surface rather than omitted.
